blocks.heading: The project
blocks.body:
Welcome to Alzaytoun Residences, where contemporary design meets refined execution to offer a complete living experience. More than a residence, a thriving community offering comfort, privacy, and quality living in Baghdad's green zone.

Reviving the relationship between humans and nature in Baghdad's heart. Inspired by the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Alzaytoun reinterprets this historical symbol with contemporary vision, merging green spaces with modern architecture.

blocks.text: Reviving the Hanging Gardens of Babylon in modern Baghdad.

blocks.body:
Every exceptional project begins with a question worth answering. For Alzaytoun, that question was simple: How can we revive the spirit of the Hanging Gardens in modern Baghdad?

For millennia, gardens have symbolized Iraqi civilization. Spaces where humans meet nature, where beauty and life converge. Rather than surrounding buildings with green space, we asked: What if green space is the building?

Alzaytoun Residences is not a residential complex with landscaping. It is a vision where nature is integrated into architecture itself. Every terrace, every pathway, every shared space is designed so that residents do not visit gardens. They live in them.

Drawing on 5,000 years of Mesopotamian heritage while embracing contemporary design excellence, Alzaytoun bridges past and future. It is a project that respects history, celebrates nature, and redefines what luxury living in Baghdad can be.

blocks.label: Brand identity
blocks.text: A design language rooted in purpose.

blocks.heading: A vision rooted in heritage
blocks.body: Nature is not added as decoration. Architecture is built around it. Every green space is designed as a daily-life extension. Natural light, clean air, and greenery become standard amenities, creating an environment that is tranquil, balanced, and sustainable.

blocks.text: Life at Alzaytoun is measured by what you feel, not by square meters.

blocks.body: Living begins between gardens, extends through green pathways, continues in shared community spaces. Nature becomes part of every day.
The tree and circular emblem is a botanical illustration representing heritage, permanence, and natural integration. It carries the brand across signage, collateral, and environmental design.

Dark Forest Green (#2D4A3E) is the foundation: heritage, nature, permanence, and the literal landscape strategy. Gold and warm metallics (#C9A876) mark the luxury details and premium moments. Cream and off-white provide breathing room and readability. Neutrals support flexibility across all applications.

Playfair Display carries the headlines, premium moments, and heritage connection. Inter handles body copy, UI, and supporting text for accessibility. The hierarchy runs from H1 at 56-64px Playfair through to body text at 16-18px Inter. Usage extends to signage, unit naming (The Avenue Suite, The Panorama, The Crown Penthouse), and marketing materials.

blocks.heading: Architectural overview
blocks.body:
Two residential towers form an integrated architectural identity, connected by bridges that are both functional and sculptural. Vertical lines create a strong skyline presence, while cascading terraces and green spaces suggest movement and lightness, evoking the Hanging Gardens aesthetic with contemporary refinement.

Ground-level design prioritizes comfort and elegance: carefully planned entrances, open community spaces, and a balance between privacy and social connection.

blocks.heading: The Avenue Suite
blocks.body:
1-Bedroom Residence · 117.34 m² base · 206.41 m² total

Practical luxury for professionals and couples. Master bedroom with dressing room and en-suite, spacious living and dining flow, functional kitchen, guest powder room, and private terrace overlooking the gardens.

blocks.heading: The Panorama Apartment
blocks.body:
2-Bedroom Residence · 188.81 m² base · 349.55 m² total

Family elegance integrated seamlessly. Two master bedrooms with dressing rooms and en-suites, generously proportioned living and dining spaces, practical kitchen, guest powder room, storage, laundry room, and a wide terrace capturing garden views.

blocks.heading: The Grand Residence
blocks.body:
3-Bedroom Residence · 188.00 m² base · 358.90 m² total

Premium family living with private indulgence. Master bedroom plus two additional bedrooms, spacious living and dining, practical kitchen, private swimming pool, extensive terraces, and the luxury of personal water retreat.

blocks.heading: The Meridian Residence
blocks.body:
4-Bedroom Residence · 323.58 m² base · 601.80 m² total

Spacious luxury for large families. Four master bedrooms, two living and dining areas to accommodate multifaceted family life, cold and hot kitchens for entertaining and daily convenience, dedicated staff accommodations with private en-suite, laundry room, and expansive terraces with open views.

blocks.heading: The Signature Duplex
blocks.body:
5-Bedroom, 2-Floor Residence · 574.06 m² base · 952.04 m² total

Peak luxury and privacy across two thoughtfully designed levels. Five master bedrooms, separate family lounge and living reception, expansive dining, cold and hot kitchens, staff accommodations, private swimming pool, storage, and extensive outdoor living spaces that redefine residential excellence.

blocks.heading: The Crown Penthouse
blocks.body:
4+Guest Bedroom, 2-Floor Residence · 700.10 m² base · 1,297.97 m² total

Highest expression of residential luxury. Four master bedrooms plus guest bedroom distributed across two levels, separate receptions, family living areas, expansive dining, cold and hot kitchens, dedicated study room, luxury dressing rooms, staff accommodations, wide terraces, and panoramic sitting areas offering 360-degree Baghdad vistas.

items.title: Green Spaces
items.body: Gardens and terraces emphasizing nature as daily lifestyle. Designed to restore balance and connect residents to Baghdad's natural rhythms.

items.title: Smart Home Technology
items.body: Intelligent control of lighting, security, and home systems. Modern convenience seamlessly integrated into luxury living.

items.title: Landscape and Views
items.body: Every unit designed for open views on gardens and natural surroundings. Landscape architecture prioritizes beauty and privacy.

items.title: Swimming Pools
items.body: Luxury residences include private pools. All residents enjoy community aquatic spaces for recreation and wellness.

items.title: Wide Terraces
items.body: Natural extensions of living spaces, designed in the spirit of Hanging Gardens. Places to live, not just look out from.

items.title: Integrated Community
items.body: Residential units, open spaces, daily services, and recreational facilities form a complete living ecosystem.

items.title: Privacy and Security
items.body: Organized entrances, controlled circulation, secure family environment. Luxury paired with peace of mind.

items.title: Strategic Location
items.body: Green Zone prestige. Minutes from Tigris River, University of Baghdad, Al-Zawraa Park, Central Bank, Republican Palace, and principal commercial centres.

blocks.body:
Situated within Baghdad's Green Zone, directly behind the Movenpick Zaitoun Hotel, Alzaytoun Residences occupies a location that balances exclusivity with accessibility. Surrounded by government institutions, cultural landmarks, educational hubs, and commercial centres, residents enjoy proximity to Baghdad's vital infrastructure while maintaining serene, private community life.

Unique balance: city vibrancy and residential tranquility. Investment value meets quality of life.

blocks.heading: International Free Company (IFC)
blocks.body: A leading Iraqi engineering, supply, and construction firm with extensive experience in infrastructure, energy, and major urban development projects. Track record includes Movenpick Zaitoun Hotel Baghdad, Baghdad Garden Complex, and regional energy sector initiatives. Mission: quality-driven, sustainable projects that elevate Baghdad's urban landscape.

blocks.heading: Manhal Habboubi Architectural Office
blocks.body: Prominent Iraqi architecture firm specializing in contemporary design informed by cultural heritage. Design inspired by Babylon's Hanging Gardens, with modern execution of historical symbolism. Focus on balanced living environments, natural light optimization, and open views. Expertise in large-scale residential, urban planning, and cultural heritage reinterpretation.

blocks.text: Nature is not added as decoration. Architecture is built around it.
